entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Shitla Prasad Tripathi,Amresh Singh,Arpit Chaudhary Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Abhineet Jaiswal,Gaurav Mehrotra,Nadeem Murtaza,Tusha Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard Sri Pawan Kumar Yadav, Advocate holding brief of Sri Shitala Prasad Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Gaurav Mehrotra for respondent no. 2, learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

The instant application has been filed with a prayer to quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1432 of 2019 pending before the Court of the Ld. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Vth, room no. 28,
Lucknow arising out of Case Crime No. 0306 of 2018, P.S. Bakshi Ka Talab, under Sections 420,
504, 506 of IPC along with the summoning order dated 29.07.2019, charge sheet no. 01 dated 10.05.2019 and all the proceedings initiated in pursuance thereto.

entities.text:

sentences.text:

Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39660527/
1 24.04.2023 referred the matter to the Mediation and Conciliation Center of this Court, wherein, the parties vide settlement agreement dated 28.04.2023, has resolved their dispute.

entities.text: Sarvesh Kumar Yadav @ Sarvesh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further submission is that now there is no grievance of the parties against each other and thus there is no fate of the trial and the criminal proceeding against the present applicant may be quashed.

On the other hand, the learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 has also supported the version of the learned counsel for the applicant and submits that the parties have settled their dispute and thus the criminal proceeding may be dropped.
The learned AGA appearing for the State, though has opposed the contention on merits, but he has no objection if the parties have settled their dispute amicably.
Considering the submission of the learned counsel for the parties, it emerges that the parties have settled their dispute before the Mediation and Conciliation Center.
In this regard, the Mediator has also sent his report dated 28.04.2023 and has reported that the mediation succeeded.
Along with the report, the settlement agreement is also appended.
Since, the parties have settled their dispute therefore, further the criminal proceeding would be a futile exercise.

Resultantly, the criminal proceeding pertaining to of Criminal Case No. 1432 of 2019arising out of Case Crime No. 0306 of 2018, under Sections 420, 504, 506 of IPC P.S. Bakshi Ka Talab, District Lucknow is hereby quashed.
The application is allowed.
The settlement agreement dated 28.04.2023 shall be part of this order.
Consequences to be followed.
Consigned to record.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Anurag  Sarvesh Kumar Yadav @ Sarvesh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...
